result:
0	A new book, the book of Shemot, which the Rambam calls the book of exile and redemption.	Um livro novo, o livro de Shemot, que o Rambam chama de livro do exílio e da redenção.
1	The book of Shemot has very fascinating parashiot at its beginning and very intricate ones at its end.	No livro de Shemot, há parashiot fascinantes no começo e parashiot muito complexas no fim.
2	Shemot, Va'era, Bo, Beshalach, Yitro, Mishpatim, Terumah, Tetzaveh, Ki Tisa: these are the most interesting parashiot.	Shemot, Vaerá, Bo, Beshalach, Yitro, Mishpatim, Terumá, Tetzavê, Ki Tissá: essas são as parashiot mais interessantes.
3	Then Terumah and Tetzaveh are a bit harder, and then at the end we have Vayakhel,	Depois, Terumá e Tetzavê são um pouco mais difíceis, e no fim temos Vayakhel,
4	which are somewhat more complex in this book, the book of Shemot: Vayakhel.	que são um pouco mais complexas neste livro, o livro de Shemot: Vayakhel.
5	That is the last of these parashiot: Ki Tisa, Vayakhel,	Essa é a última dessas parashiot: Ki Tissá, Vayakhel,
6	Pekudei.	Pekudei.
7	These are the last ones.	Essas são as últimas.
8	And a few of these four parashiot, Ki Tisa, Vayakhel, in Ki Tisa we will speak about the calf, and there is still a lot	E nessas quatro parashiot, Ki Tissá, Vayakhel, em Ki Tissá falaremos do bezerro, e ainda há muito
9	to delve into there, but we need to understand all these parashiot too, which are a bit more intricate.	a aprofundar ali, mas é preciso entender também todas essas parashiot, que são um pouco mais complexas.
10	"And these are the names of the children of Israel who came to Egypt with Jacob, each man and his household came: Reuben,	"Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Israel que vieram ao Egito com Yaakov, cada qual veio com sua casa: Reuven,
11	Simeon, Levi and Judah, Issachar, Zebulun and Benjamin, Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher. And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob	Shimon, Levi e Yehudá, Yissachar, Zevulun e Binyamin, Dan e Naftali, Gad e Asher. E todas as almas que saíram da descendência de Yaakov
12	were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt."	eram setenta almas, e Yosef estava no Egito."
13	The Zohar asks, Zohar on Shemot, page 16a: what does "and Joseph was in Egypt" mean?	O Zohar pergunta, Zohar de Shemot, folha 16a: o que significa "e Yosef estava no Egito"?
14	It is obvious that Joseph was in Egypt.	É óbvio que Yosef estava no Egito.
15	What is the novelty? The verse says, "All the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls, and Joseph was	Qual é a novidade? O verso diz: "Todas as almas que saíram da descendência de Yaakov eram setenta almas, e Yosef estava
16	in Egypt."	no Egito."
17	So on the plain level, it comes to tell you that we do not count Joseph.	Então, no nível simples, vem dizer que não contamos Yosef.
18	There are seventy souls without Joseph.	São setenta almas sem Yosef.
19	Why?	Por quê?
20	"Your fathers went down to Egypt with seventy souls," and it did not count Joseph.	"Com setenta almas desceram teus pais ao Egito", e não contou Yosef.
21	But according to the secret, the Zohar explains, "and Joseph was in Egypt" tells you that even after he passed away, he was	Mas segundo o segredo, o Zohar explica, "e Yosef estava no Egito" diz que mesmo depois de falecer ele estava
22	in Egypt.	no Egito.
23	He did not leave them.	Ele não os abandonou.
24	They had a very, very hard and very, very complex bondage.	Eles tinham uma escravidão muito, muito dura e muito, muito complexa.
25	Wicked Pharaoh would bathe in infants, in the blood of infants; the magicians told him he had become leprous.	O malvado Faraó se banhava em bebês, no sangue dos bebês; os magos disseram a ele que estava com lepra.
26	And the Gemara says that when the magicians told him he had become leprous, they told him the way to cure the affliction was to take the blood of	E a Guemará diz que, quando os magos disseram que ele estava leproso, disseram que o modo de curar o mal era tomar o sangue de
27	Jewish children, infants, fill a bathtub, and bathe in their blood.	crianças judias, bebês, encher uma banheira e se banhar no sangue deles.
28	So he would bathe, the Midrash says like this: he would slaughter 150 infants.	Então ele se banhava; assim diz o Midrash: ele abatia 150 bebês.
29	For his bath, 150 infants, and he bathed in the infants' blood.	Para o seu banho, 150 bebês, e se banhava no sangue dos bebês.
30	Moshe Rabenu was greatly perplexed: "This is Torah, and this is its reward?" What did the infants do to deserve such punishment	Moshé Rabênu ficou muito perplexo: "Esta é a Torá e esta é a sua recompensa?" O que fizeram os bebês para merecer tal castigo
31	and sin?	e culpa?
32	So the Holy One, blessed be He, said to him: do not look at the jug, but at what is in it. Do not look at this one here,	Então o Santo, bendito seja, disse a ele: não olhe para o jarro, mas para o que há nele. Não olhe para isto aqui,
33	150 infants in the morning, 150 infants in the evening; do not look, but at what is in it.	150 bebês de manhã, 150 bebês à noite; não olhe, mas para o que há dentro.
34	These are souls of wicked people, and this is their rectification, to be slaughtered.	São almas de ímpios, e essa é a retificação deles: serem abatidos.
35	But it was hard for Moshe Rabenu to accept this.	Mas foi difícil para Moshé Rabênu aceitar isso.
36	Still, there was great anguish, and they had the bondage of Egypt, which was very	Mesmo assim, havia grande sofrimento, e eles tinham a escravidão do Egito, que era muito
37	hard for them.	dura para eles.
38	And so what the Holy One, blessed be He, did was leave Joseph with them in Egypt.	E por isso o Santo, bendito seja, deixou Yosef com eles no Egito.
39	Every time they had a little anguish, what do you do when there is anguish?	Toda vez que sentiam um pouco de aflição, o que se faz quando há aflição?
